scenario.title: Simple English, strong clinical rapport
scenario.patient_background: Limited English proficiency, first hospital stay.

transcript.content: Hello Ahmed, I am nurse Kim. How you feeling today?
I am scared. Will I need operation again?
I understand you are scared, this is very normal feeling. Let me explain for you.
The infection is getting better with the medicine. Doctor think you will not need operation, but we watch you close.
That is good to hear, thank you.
You have understand what I explain? You can ask me anything, no problem.
Yes I understand, thank you nurse.

audio.note: This benchmark contains no real audio recordings for any case. Base Intelligibility and Fluency on genuine acoustic evidence only; since none exists here, mark both status="limited_evidence", level=null for every case in this package. Do not infer pronunciation or spoken fluency from transcript spelling or word choice.
